svg.aria-label: How VoteTrace fits Nigeria's election process
svg.text: How VoteTrace fits Nigeria's election process
An independent check on every polling-unit result sheet
Every polling-unit result, traceable to its evidence
VoteTrace makes each result sheet checkable: the original photo, its fingerprint, the figures read from it,
every correction and every reviewer decision. Discrepancies become visible, and nothing is verified automatically.
